import os
import sys


def main():

        text = f.read()

    # Mapping from each distinct word to its length
    word_lengths = {}
    for word in text.split():
        word_lengths[word] = len(word)

    # Discard entries whose length is 3 or less, then sum the remaining lengths
    total = sum(length for length in word_lengths.values() if length > 3)

    os.makedirs("./out", exist_ok=True)
    with open("./out/answer.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(str(total) + "\n")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import os
import sys


def main():
    with open("./data/sentence.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        text = f.read()

    # Mapping from each distinct word to its length
    word_lengths = {}
    for word in text.split():
        word_lengths[word] = len(word)

    # Discard entries whose length is 3 or less, then sum the remaining lengths
    total = sum(length for length in word_lengths.values() if length > 3)

    os.makedirs("./out", exist_ok=True)
    with open("./out/answer.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(str(total) + "\n")

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
